## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

Follow-up to the [earlier review](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12955#issuecomment-5785590525) and the [author's fix note](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12955#issuecomment-5800566593), checked at `cbd90b31`.

**Verified:** the earlier tray finding is resolved. Two narrower tray-menu timing issues and one agents-panel label issue are new at this head.

| Earlier item | Status at `cbd90b31` |
|---|---|
| Ready tray menus cannot open (`children.length`) | **Resolved.** `TrayModel.menuModelHasChildren` reads `children.values`, and both the click path and `onChildrenChanged` use it. |
| Optional test note: test passed on the broken head | **Resolved.** The new test fails when the helper or either `Tray.qml` call site reads `.length`. |

**Verified by source inspection (Quickshell 0.3.1):**
- A first menu load fills the rows before `QsMenuOpener` emits `childrenChanged`, so the late-open path sees them and opens the menu.
- Removing the `item.display(...)` fallback for items without a menu loses nothing: in 0.3.1, `display()` only logs "No menu present" and returns when the item has no menu handle.
- If the app exits while its menu is open, the popup now closes instead of keeping an empty focus grab.
- Compared with `0778d2f5`, only `Tray.qml`, `TrayModel.js` and `tray-unready-sni-test.sh` changed. The earlier Verified notes for the other files still apply.

## Tray menu ignores row changes inside a loaded menu

The handler at [`Tray.qml:518-524`](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/blob/cbd90b31bf92d5150c1b3b036b6ac7e657733e3c/shell/plugins/bar/widgets/Tray.qml#L518-L524) listens only to `QsMenuOpener.childrenChanged`. In Quickshell 0.3.1 that signal fires when the menu handle loads, is replaced, unloads or is destroyed. Rows added or removed by a D-Bus `LayoutUpdated` change the existing `ObjectModel` in place and emit only its `valuesChanged`.

```text
Event                                              childrenChanged?   Head result
first layout has rows                              yes                opens
first layout empty, rows added later (same model)  no                 stays closed until a second click
open menu loses its last visible row               no                 stays open and empty (same as base)
```

**Impact:** For an app whose first menu layout has no visible rows, the click does not open the menu when the rows arrive. The author's invariant "a menu must open once rows exist" holds only when rows are present in the first layout.

**Suggested change:** Also run the same readiness check from `Connections { target: trayMenuOpener.children; function onValuesChanged() { ... } }`. The target rebinds when `children` changes.

**Optional test improvement:** The late-ready and "zero rows" assertions in `tray-unready-sni-test.sh` pin only the `if` conditions. A diagnostic mutation that makes the late-ready branch set `trayMenuOpen = false` still passes. Asserting the assignment in each branch would catch that.

## Tray menu can open without a pending click

`close()` keeps `activeTrayItem` set, and the handler opens whenever rows appear while `trayMenuOpen` is false. In Quickshell 0.3.1 source, two situations deliver such an event without a new click:

- The first layout for a clicked item fails or is slow and later succeeds. There is no timeout or cancellation, including after another bar popup was opened in the meantime.
- After the user has dismissed the menu, the app announces a different or temporarily empty `Menu` object path through D-Bus `PropertiesChanged`. The handle reloads and `childrenChanged` fires with rows.

**Impact:** In either case the tray popup opens on its own, can replace another open bar popup and takes the focus grab. How often real tray apps trigger these paths was not measured.

**Suggested change:** Open from the handler only while a user-initiated open is pending. Set a flag in `openTrayMenu()` and clear it in `close()` and when the popout is lost.

## `(est.)` marker matches any label containing "est"

In [`agents/Panel.qml:94`](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/blob/cbd90b31bf92d5150c1b3b036b6ac7e657733e3c/shell/plugins/agents/Panel.qml#L94), `/est\.?/i` matches the letters "est" anywhere in the label. A probe that evaluated the head's `windowTitle`:

```text
Requests (daily)  ->  Requests (est.)
Latest window     ->  Latest window (est.)
Test quota        ->  Test quota (est.)
Weekly (est.)     ->  Weekly (est.)     (intended)
```

**Impact:** Limits from collectors whose labels contain "est" inside a word are marked estimated when they are not. None of the in-tree collectors emits such a label today. The plugin documentation invites third-party collectors.

**Suggested change:** Match a delimited marker, for example `/\best(?:imated?)?\b/i` or an explicit `(est.)` token.
